# Stranded XMRig member review

Controls cover indexed XOR assignment versus comparison, a batch miner invocation
versus an echoed/commented mention, and RSA type-name references without Go
standard-library attribution. The positive XOR control is ordinary arithmetic:
its notable finding must remain, with no cipher/obfuscation claim.

The recovered WinRing0 and XMRig binaries are compared byte for byte with the
official v6.25.0 Windows x64 release, fetched with Forager. Original artifacts,
provenance, fact dumps, and disassembly are retained in the task scratch area.
`review.json` records member verdicts, hashes, before/after findings and ML scores.
